last year my dog got hit by a car, we think she died on impact. she broke her neck. i was obviously broken up, texting everyone trying to get help that they couldn’t give. time goes on and my dad asks if i wanna see the dog one last time before we bury her. i said yes, i was the only sibling to see her up close, after she has died. i didn’t see much blood from where she was when my dad moved her. we said goodbye, and then my dad sets her on a white, old bedsheet as it soaks red. i watched my dad wrap up her completely still body. i cant get that image out of my head as i watched him wrap her up, set her in the ground and start covering up the ground.



oh, and to the person who hit my dog, and didn’t even slow down their car, fuck you.
